name: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)
sub: Coordinates ICV policy, telecoms and pilot zones across China
leadership: Verify current public leadership before outreach
about: Central Chinese ministry overseeing intelligent connected vehicles, automotive industry policy, telecoms and AV pilot-zone policy coordination. A 2026 draft mandatory standard would require L3 systems to execute a minimal-risk maneuver themselves if the driver fails to respond, an L4-level fallback, and to carry an aircraft-style data recorder, proposed to take effect July 1, 2027.
model: Industrial policy, vehicle/ICV rules, pilot guidance and technology-sector oversight.
deployment: China national; municipal AV pilots operate within central guidance.
metrics: Permits, rules, reporting or type-approval authority relevant to AV deployment.
signal: China reportedly suspended new AV permits after a Baidu Apollo Go outage while authorities reviewed safety oversight.
